measure.sourceTitle: Good Morning City Copenhagen Star - Google hotels
measure.evidenceText: Google Hotels identifies Good Morning City Copenhagen Star in Copenhagen as a 3-star hotel and shows $193 nightly and $241 total for 1 night with taxes + fees. The returned evidence does not explicitly show two adults and one room for this quote.
measure.referencePeriod: Google Hotels result crawled 3 weeks ago; 10–11 July stay dates

measure.reason: Rejected: exact-city class and tax-inclusive numeric nightly quote are present, but explicit two-adult/one-room occupancy is absent in the same evidence. Query terms cannot supply occupancy evidence. Other returned results were wrong class or class-ambiguous.
